hazards.name: Driveway Conflict
hazards.description: A wide concrete driveway crosses the sidewalk, creating a potential conflict point between pedestrians and vehicles entering or exiting the property.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, crossing the sidewalk towards the white house.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Visibility Obstruction
hazards.description: A parked car on the street may partially obscure the view of pedestrians, especially children, attempting to cross the street from behind it.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left foreground.

hazards.name: Frequent driveway crossings
hazards.description: Multiple driveways create conflict points where vehicles cross the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sidewalks

hazards.name: Unpaved Driveway Crossing
hazards.description: The gravel driveway creates a break in the sidewalk surface, potentially causing tripping hazards or tracking loose stones onto the walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image where the sidewalk meets the gravel path.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible in the immediate vicinity, which may reduce pedestrian visibility and safety during nighttime hours.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire streetscape

hazards.name: Potential for high vehicle speeds
hazards.description: The wide, straight roadway lacks traffic calming or lane markings, which may encourage speeds higher than appropriate for a residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire visible stretch of the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A large pickup truck parked on the street obscures sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground right, the black pickup truck.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Vegetation
hazards.description: Mature trees and shrubs near the curb may obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Planted areas between the sidewalk and the street.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse lines marking the crosswalk are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Large bushes at the corners may block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and drivers approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Unmarked wide roadway
hazards.description: The absence of lane markings on a wide residential street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable lane positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Marking crossings at nearby intersections would improve pedestrian safety and driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Installing bulb-outs at intersections would reduce crossing distances and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to corners.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near driveways and potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install traffic calming measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential area.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with truncated domes at all intersection corners.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or curb extensions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Level
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk maintains its level and material across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune low-hanging branches and thin out dense shrubs near the driveway to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or chicanes to physically slow vehicle traffic to speeds appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: Enhanced Street Lighting
interventions.description: Ensure consistent lighting levels along the entire block to improve pedestrian visibility at night.

interventions.title: Edge Line Markings
interventions.description: Paint edge lines to visually narrow the travel lanes, which can naturally encourage slower driving speeds.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to ensure the walkway and driveway crossings are well-illuminated at night.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add edge lines or a center line to narrow the perceived travel space and discourage speeding.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant additional street trees in the grass buffer to provide shade and create a sense of enclosure that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Paving
interventions.description: Extend the concrete sidewalk material across the driveway to provide a continuous, level, and high-contrast walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety after dark.

interventions.title: Driveway Design Reinforcement
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk material and grade across the driveway to clearly signal pedestrian priority to drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove vegetation near the corners to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Vegetation Trimming
interventions.description: Prune low-hanging branches and trim bushes near the driveway to improve visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Leveling
interventions.description: Monitor and maintain the sidewalk near the large tree to prevent root heave from creating tripping hazards.
